svg.title: TrOCR document intelligence pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Three-stage pipeline: layout detection, OCR transcription with fine-tuned TrOCR, and LLM post-processing. Input is a raw document image; output is structured JSON.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What types of documents does this pipeline accept?')

g.text: Locate where text exists — no reading required

sendPrompt('What does LayoutParser add beyond text detection?')
sendPrompt('How does the Donut encoder help with layout?')
sendPrompt('How is OpenCV used for document segmentation?')

g.text: Read the handwriting — no layout reasoning required

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why start fine-tuning on trocr-small-handwritten instead of the base model?')
sendPrompt('What LoRA configuration was used for fine-tuning TrOCR?')
sendPrompt('What datasets were mixed for fine-tuning?')

g.text: Semantic extraction · field mapping · JSON generation · document understanding
Aggregates OCR output + layout metadata as structured context
